title: Compact loop-suffix theorem boundary
summary: Executes a checked post-loop suffix directly to a caller-supplied postcondition or moves another large continuation into a separate theorem boundary.
premises: A loop weakest-precondition goal whose completion continuation is substantially larger than the loop invariant endpoint
A compact assertion describing the completed loop state
Checked semantic theorems for the result or control-flow suffix
result: A checked singleton suffix reaches an arbitrary exact final-state postcondition, or a separately checked suffix theorem keeps the enclosing loop boundary compact.
